executiveSummary.headline: Protect Information Accuracy While Closing a Significant AI Visibility Gap
executiveSummary.lead: Sheraton Mallorca Arabella Golf Hotel has a significant visibility gap across the monitored AI answers. The priority is accurate control of golf, leisure and meetings information, paired with targeted investigation of where the hotel is absent—without claiming a direct revenue effect.
executiveSummary.metricsNote: Metrics describe presence in monitored AI answers—not booking conversion, traveler exposure or revenue impact.

themes.title: Measured AI Presence
themes.what: 20.6% AI consideration and 35.6% scenario presence; #3 of 4 in the defined relevant portfolio set.
themes.whyItMatters: These are certified presence measures, not booking conversion or revenue attribution.

themes.title: Accuracy and Information Control
themes.what: ADP measured 20.6% AI consideration and 35.6% scenario presence. Business center and outdoor event space were recognized in 6.5% of tested observations; golf resort, golf access, sports/golf travel, Sheraton brand and intimate meeting space were not recognized in the tested set.
themes.whyItMatters: Validate hotel facts first, then align official and partner content around a controlled source of truth.

themes.title: Technical and Commercial Follow-Through
themes.what: Marriott robots.txt returned HTTP 200 and did not disallow the property overview path, while the automated property GET redirected to default.mi and returned HTTP 403 through Akamai. HEAD returned 200.
themes.whyItMatters: Investigate technical signals cautiously and pursue commercial content only after a hotel go/no-go decision.
